spec.name: vn-hn-refining-material-v1
spec.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one isolated inventory icon. Subject: Three pale celadon refining crystal chips bound together by one short ivory cord. Broad faceted planes, one warm bronze vein, no bowl. Distinct from the single rough stable-jade chunk.
Style: VAN NGOC gameplay illustration: decisive dark petrol outline, clean three-tone cel shading, broad readable material planes. Celadon jade, petrol teal shadows, warm ivory highlights and restrained antique bronze. Warm upper-left light. Crisp hand-painted fantasy game asset, consistent with the approved bright jade-and-cloud monastery map. No photographic rendering, soft airbrush, tiny noisy filigree, bloom, labels, runes, typography, watermark or UI frame. These are art references described in text; no reference pixels are transmitted by this tool.
Composition: centered, subject occupies approximately 70 percent of the square, generous empty magenta margin on all four sides. Major forms must remain clear at 32, 48 and 64 pixels. One icon only; no contact sheet. Flat #FF00FF chromakey backdrop, no cast shadow on backdrop.
